title: ToolPatch
description: Structured metadata revision proposed by the F2 reviser (text baseline) or the S4 multimodal patch generator. Applied by specx.optim.patch.apply_patch to a ToolDefinition, producing metadata_revision+1. Never changes handler.code except op=fix_selector. Owned by Dev C.

base_metadata_revision.description: The revision this patch was generated against. Apply refuses if it does not match.

source_trial_ids.description: Failing trials whose bundles were shown to the model.

modality.description: Ablation arm that produced this patch.

param.description: For param-level ops: the input_schema property name.

value.description: New name / description / enum list / example / selector.

old_value.description: For fix_selector: the selector being replaced.
